name: Nintendo Entertainment System / Famicom
_notes: positional_default follows the RetroPad convention (NES B = RetroPad B = south, NES A = RetroPad A = east), so B/A sit side by side the way they do on a SNES pad. label_positions records the real pad, where B is left of A (west/east). Turbo A/B are emulator features, not console inputs, so they are left out; Famicom player-2 microphone is left out too.
